title: FY 2024 Consolidated Annual Report on UAP (AARO/ODNI joint)
doc_notes: This is the FY 2024 Consolidated Annual Report on UAP from AARO, which contains a summary of reported incidents including one specific close-approach encounter.

encounters.summary: A commercial aircrew reported a near miss with a cylindrical object while flying over the Atlantic Ocean off the coast of New York.
